history: f2be629f Publish compiler evidence and dashboard exports
source_assessment: 0062 already provides native M16/Y8 indirect-indexed word pseudos. Runtime folding has both an entry guard and an all-users guard that admit only bytes. rdw requires bounding its scaled offset; cp8 requires bounding the byte PHI plus 8. Branch legalization precedes memory legalization, so the single-block proof recognizes both G_ICMP and the exact G_SBC zero-flag branch, with either edge orientation. Existing 0066 legalization repair remains unchanged.
binary_assessment: Fresh baseline llc built against the captured live source; experimental llc built using a separate build tree and a bind-mounted candidate legalizer. Both consume identical pre-legalizer MIR. Earlier session trial rebuilt only llc but invoked unchanged clang, and retained the byte-only all-users guard; it does not establish candidate failure.
decision: No new compiler correctness defect or change to the existing fixed record. Keep the off-by-default experiment as retained evidence; installed compiler and active patch stack are unchanged.
